technical-summary: After strict role-specific validation, fresh measuring and serving manifests are snapshotted from bounded no-follow regular-file reads into sealed descriptors. The session uses the sealed execution path for power admission, helper/engine argv, runtime guards, calibration reads, and stored-byte checks; measuring children inherit the descriptor. Stored replay attestation now compares against the digest of the bytes already authenticated, avoiding a second pathname read. Focused serving, stored replay, native projection and v3 wire checks pass.
